args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following its latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Service confirmed healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate down to 0.2%. Follow-up needed to investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Verified the service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the diagnosis and rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation — the incident notes the needed follow-up.
